finding_text: Property (judging scope, may be deferred to a filed bead): text that a browser does not render must not name an id. 'None. plan-one' counts plan-one (section "None. plan-one\n"). The hidden attribute hides the span in a browser. CSS hiding (style=display:none) is the same class and cannot be closed at the Markdown level, so a deferral with this text, or an evidenced statement that attribute and CSS hiding are out of scope, is an acceptable disposition.
